title: 第十九章 修行的方向第二十章 幽夜的教导
lines: 经历过了生死危机，夜天云四人得知了自己的弱小，很快便再次投入到了修炼之中。
小南因在之前的战斗中误打误撞的使用了纸盾，且她热爱折纸，正在乐此不疲的研究着纸盾的开发，弥彦则是为自己的弱小而不甘，加倍的努力修行，常把自己弄得筋疲力竭才肯罢休。作为忍者，两人的类型已大致确定，自来也便将重点转移到夜天云和长门身上。
自来也已经把夜天云的能力当做一种特殊罕有的血迹，便升起了帮助夜天云掌控血迹的心思，但由于是斩魄刀是自己最大的秘密，夜天云自然婉言谢绝。
自来也有些失望，只好帮助长门去掌握轮回眼，不过长门在觉醒了轮回眼后修行的进境更是一日千里，自来也倒也有很多空闲的时间。
对此，夜天云也十分高兴，经常去请教自来也，因为此时的他已经粗略定制了自己未来的发展道路。
夜天云身负风火雷三属性，风雷两属性是原着中提及最多的，也是自己了解最多的。作为原着中最着名了螺旋丸和千鸟两大招牌忍术，若夜天云说完全没兴趣，那便是在撒谎。至于火属性，夜天云只当其是锦上添花了。
因此，夜天云只要一得空便询问有关于查克拉性质变化的知识。
“自来也老师，风属性和雷属性的性质有哪些。”
自来也一听，便来了兴趣，暗叹夜天云思想的前卫。”风属性是锋锐，讲究的是一个薄字，就像刀锋，越薄越容易切割；雷属性不同，雷十分狂暴，你看雷雨天落下的闪电可以将大树劈成焦炭，雷属性的破坏力可以说是首屈一指的。”
看着全神贯注聆听同时又若有所思的夜天云，自来也忽然一笑。
“你想知道修行的方法吧，虽然现在对你们来说接触这些有点早，但也无妨，自来也便仔仔细细的教导着两种查克拉属性的修行方式。
修行的方式和原着中大同小异，依旧是切割树叶，风属性是将树叶切断，而雷属性则是让树叶变得褶皱。夜天云将自来也所教的方法熟记于心，便自行领悟去了。
风克雷，一般来说身负相克属性查克拉的忍者最终都会放弃一种转而专攻另一种，因为若同时修行，两者会逐渐相斥，修习的效果便会事半功倍。
究其原因，还是因为查克拉的控制力，若想同时控制相克的查克拉并非没有可能，只是查克拉的控制力要求极高，甚至是非人力所及。
不过夜天云有他自己的想法，如今只是初步修行查克拉的性质变化，一切等到完成后再视情况而定。
半个星期后，夜天云将风雷两种属性的初步修炼——树叶训练法已然完成，即便知道夜天云天赋惊人，但如此短的时间便完成修炼任务还是让自来也小小吃惊了一下。
看到了夜天云的进步，自来也便将雷属性查克拉的初步运用——炼体教给了夜天云。
雷属性炼体并不难，只是将雷属性查克拉的变化作用到肌肉上，刺激肌肉，让其瞬间产生超越性的爆发力。获得这种技巧的夜天云也十分高兴，这给了他一个机会去改善鬼闪的缺点，那三丈的极限。
找了一处僻静所在，夜天云将雷属性查克拉作用在小腿上，不多时，一股酥麻酸痛的感觉从小腿处传来，不过他也能清晰的感觉到小腿的肌肉已经紧绷，双腿越发的有力。感受到双腿能承受的雷属性查克拉已接近了极限，夜天云双腿一屈，脚下发力，使用了鬼闪。
夜天云感到此次的鬼闪相较于以前大为不同，更加迅疾，甚至泛起一丝残像，不过却少了几分诡异灵动，待到夜天云站定后，已在二十米开外。
“直线运动确实迅疾，但小范围的闪转腾挪便没那么灵活了。”夜天云下了自己的判断。
“不过既然雷属性可以刺激肌肉，那风属性可不可以也附着在身上？”夜天云脑海中闪过这丝想法，说道做到，便立即试验起来。
果不其然，当夜天云运用风属性查克拉附着在身躯上时，顿时感到轻盈了许多，立刻使用鬼闪试验起来。
乘奔而御风，风除了锋利以外，还飘忽不定，使得鬼闪变得更加如鬼如魅，不过，看着纵跃的距离，夜天云双眉微蹙。
“十五米。”
加入了风属性的鬼闪，闪转腾挪更胜从前，但相对于充满爆炸力的雷属性，纵跃的距离和直线速度都要差了不少，虽然夜天云只是初步运用了两种属性的查克拉，增幅的效果并不明显，但两者风格和发展方向却是可见一斑。
经过了仔细的考虑，夜天云还是准备暂时运用雷属性炼体加强鬼闪的使用，多出了五米的距离，可能便是生死之隔。
而且他相信，随着雷属性查克拉运用的愈加精通，鬼闪会被逐渐完善。
找到了破除鬼闪弱点的途径，夜天云便想将原着中最着名的忍术——螺旋丸开发出来，之所以选择螺旋丸是因为相对于千鸟，没有噪音的螺旋丸拥有更大的机会在乱战中击中敌人。
content_en:
After experiencing the crisis of life and death, Ye Tianyun and the others learned about their own weakness and soon devoted themselves to cultivation again.
Konan accidentally used a paper shield in the previous battle, and she loves origami and is studying the development of the paper shield with great joy. Yahiko is unwilling to accept his weakness and redoubles his efforts in practice, often exhausting himself before giving up. As ninjas, the two types were roughly determined, so Jiraiya shifted his focus to Ye Tianyun and Nagato.
Jiraiya had already regarded Ye Tianyun's ability as a special and rare blood stain, and he aroused the idea of ​​helping Ye Tianyun control the blood stain. However, since the Zanpakutō was his biggest secret, Ye Tianyun naturally declined politely.
Jiraiya was a little disappointed and had no choice but to help Nagato master the Samsara Eye. However, Nagato's practice progressed even faster after awakening the Samsara Eye, and Jiraiya also had a lot of free time.
Ye Tianyun was also very happy about this and often consulted Jiraiya, because at this time he had roughly customized his future development path.
Ye Tianyun possesses the three attributes of wind, fire and thunder. The two attributes of wind and thunder are the most mentioned in the original work and the ones he knows the most about. As the two most famous signature ninjutsus of the Rasengan and Chidori in the original work, Ye Tianyun would be lying if he said he was not interested at all. As for the fire attribute, Ye Tianyun only regarded it as the icing on the cake.
Therefore, Ye Tianyun asked for knowledge about the changes in the nature of chakra whenever he had time.
"Jiraiya-sensei, what are the properties of wind and thunder attributes."
When Jiraiya heard this, he became interested and secretly sighed at Ye Tianyun's avant-garde thinking. "The wind attribute is sharp, which means thin, just like a blade. The thinner it is, the easier it is to cut. The thunder attribute is different. Thunder is very violent. You can see that the lightning falling in a thunderstorm can split a big tree into charcoal. The destructive power of the thunder attribute can be said to be second to none."
Looking at Ye Tianyun who was listening intently and thoughtfully at the same time, Jiraiya suddenly smiled.
"You want to know how to practice. Although it is a little early for you to come into contact with these, it doesn't matter. Jiraiya carefully taught the two methods of practicing chakra attributes.
The method of practice is similar to that in the original work. It still involves cutting leaves. The wind attribute cuts the leaves, while the thunder attribute makes the leaves wrinkle. Ye Tianyun memorized the method taught by Jiraiya and understood it on his own.
Feng Clay, generally speaking, ninjas with chakras of competing attributes will eventually give up one chakra and specialize in the other, because if they practice at the same time, the two will gradually repel each other, and the effect of practice will be twice the result with half the effort.
The reason is due to the control of chakra. It is not impossible to control conflicting chakras at the same time, but the control of chakra requires extremely high requirements, even beyond human reach.
However, Ye Tianyun has his own ideas. Now he is only practicing the changes in the nature of chakra. Everything will depend on the situation after it is completed.
Half a week later, Ye Tianyun had completed the preliminary training of the two attributes of wind and thunder - the leaf training method. Even though he knew that Ye Tianyun had amazing talent, Jiraiya was still a little surprised by completing the training task in such a short time.
Seeing Ye Tianyun's progress, Jiraiya taught Ye Tianyun the preliminary application of thunder attribute chakra - body refining.
It is not difficult to train the body with the thunder attribute. It only requires the changes of the thunder attribute chakra to be applied to the muscles, stimulating the muscles and causing them to instantly produce transcendent explosive power. Ye Tianyun was also very happy to obtain this skill. It gave him an opportunity to improve the shortcomings of Guishan, the limit of three feet.
After finding a secluded place, Ye Tianyun applied thunder attribute chakra to his calves. After a while, a numb and sore feeling came from his calves, but he could also clearly feel that the muscles in his calves were tight and his legs were getting stronger. Feeling that the amount of thunder chakra his legs could bear was approaching the limit, Ye Tianyun bent his legs, exerted force under his feet, and used Ghost Flash.
Ye Tianyun felt that the ghost flash this time was very different from before. It was faster and even had a trace of afterimage, but it was a little less weird and agile. By the time Ye Tianyun stood still, it was already twenty meters away.
"Linear movement is really fast, but small-scale flickering is not that flexible. "Ye Tianyun made his own judgment.
“But since the thunder attribute can stimulate muscles, can the wind attribute also be attached to the body? "This thought flashed through Ye Tianyun's mind, and he said he could do it, and immediately started testing it.
Sure enough, when Ye Tianyun used wind attribute chakra to attach to his body, he suddenly felt much lighter and immediately started experimenting with ghost flash.
Riding on the wind, the wind was not only sharp, but also erratic, making Guishian even more ghost-like. However, looking at the distance of the leap, Ye Tianyun frowned slightly.
"Fifteen meters. "
With the addition of the wind attribute Ghost Flash, the dodge and move are better than before, but compared to the explosive thunder attribute, the vertical jump distance and straight-line speed are much worse. Although Ye Tianyun has only initially used the chakra of the two attributes, the effect of the increase is not obvious, but the styles and development directions of the two are evident.
After careful consideration, Ye Tianyun decided to temporarily use the thunder attribute to refine his body to enhance the use of ghost flash. The extra five meters of distance could be the difference between life and death.
And he believes that as he becomes more proficient in the use of thunder attribute chakra, ghost flash will be gradually perfected.
After finding a way to eliminate the weakness of the ghost flash, Ye Tianyun wanted to develop the most famous ninjutsu in the original work-the Rasengan. The reason why he chose the Rasengan was because compared to Chidori, the noiseless Rasengan has a greater chance of hitting the enemy in a chaotic battle.
